name: hcapp_getPhotoUploadToken
description: Validates auth, then returns the userId, kennelId, and kennelSlug so the calling Azure Function can construct a scoped SAS write token for the trail-photos blob container. Any authenticated HC user may call this — no kennel membership or following check is required. No side effects and no DB writes — pure auth check plus a single Kennel lookup.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel the photo will be uploaded under. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode 1230, errorType 12).

parameters.name: photoGuid
parameters.description: Client-generated GUID for the photo. Validated to be non-null and non-zero-UUID (errorCode 1230, errorType 12). Not stored in the DB by this SP — used by the Azure Function when constructing the SAS blob path.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: On auth or validation failure: success=0, errorCode and errorType set. On success: success=1, errorCode=NULL, errorType=NULL. Always present.

columns.name: success
columns.description: 1 on success, 0 on auth or validation failure.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. NULL on success.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification code. NULL on success.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Returned only on auth or validation failure. Follows the standard HC6 error detail shape. Not present on success.

rowsets.name: TokenData
rowsets.description: On success: userId, kennelId, and kennelSlug needed by the Azure Function to scope the SAS token. If @kennelId does not match any Kennel row, this rowset will be empty (zero rows) with no error — callers should guard against an empty result. Mutually exclusive with ErrorDetail at index 1.

columns.name: userId
columns.description: The authenticated user's HC.Hasher.id — resolved by ValidateAppAuth.

columns.name: kennelSlug
columns.description: Kennel.KennelUniqueShortName — used by the Azure Function to construct the blob container path.

sideEffects: Writes to HC.ErrorLog on validation failures only. No other side effects.

codeSmells.issue: Missing Kennel existence check — empty TokenData rowset on unknown kennelId
codeSmells.detail: The final SELECT queries HC.Kennel WHERE k.id = @kennelId. If @kennelId is a valid UUID format but does not match any kennel row, the TokenData rowset returns zero rows with success=1. The Azure Function caller receives a success envelope but no data to work with. A NOT EXISTS check and explicit error response would be safer.
The SP has no TRY/CATCH block. An unexpected DB error will propagate as a raw SQL error rather than a structured error rowset.

codeSmells.issue: HcVersion hardcoded to '<unknown>' in all ErrorLog inserts
codeSmells.detail: Consistent with other HC6 SPs but means the version is never captured in the error log.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
